objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign274 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign274 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer operating demand, supply continuity and customer concentration reflected in lawful point-in-time value-added-tax invoice network activity.
Issuer organizational expansion, contraction and operating-footprint change reflected in public branch and subsidiary registration lifecycle events.
Issuer fiscal compliance and liquidity stress reflected in public tax-credit classifications, arrears and enforcement transitions.
Issuer asset control, collateralization and financing constraint reflected in public land-title, mortgage and encumbrance lifecycle records.
Issuer production authorization and environmental operating constraint reflected in public permit, emissions and compliance lifecycle records.
Issuer market-access and process-quality capability reflected in public product certification, testing and accreditation lifecycle records.
Issuer workforce scale, continuity and compliance reflected in lawful aggregate social-insurance contribution and employer-status records.
